title: Three Days of Snow
cn: 第 13 集 · 三天的雪
novel:
A [[blizzard|blizzard]] hit New York. Snow fell for three days straight, [[paralyzing|paralyze]] the city. Lily was [[stranded|strand]] at the airport, trying to get home to Marshall.

Every year, Marshall and Lily had a [[tradition|tradition]]. They would meet at MacLaren's on the first day of snow and drink warm [[cocoa|cocoa]]. This year, the storm [[threatened|threaten]] to break it.

"I'll get there," Lily [[promised|promise]] on the phone. "No matter what."

Meanwhile, Ted and Barney [[ran|run]] MacLaren's bar while the bartender was away. They [[renamed|rename]] drinks and [[invented|invent]] crazy rules. "No sad faces allowed," Barney [[declared|declare]].

The bar was packed with people [[escaping|escape]] the storm. Ted and Barney felt like kings — until they [[realized|realize]] they had no idea how to mix drinks. [[Chaos|chaos]] [[erupted|erupt]].

Marshall waited at MacLaren's alone, watching the snow fall. He almost gave up. Then the door opened. Lily stood there, covered in snow, [[shivering|shiver]] but smiling.

"You made it," Marshall [[whispered|whisper]].

"I [[promised|promise]]," she said.

They sat together with their cocoa, and the tradition [[survived|survive]].

Barney and Ted, meanwhile, were [[fired|fire]] from their one-day bartending job. "Worst bartenders ever," the real bartender said. They could not even [[argue|argue]].

blizzard.en: a severe snow storm with strong winds

paralyze.en: to make something unable to move or work

strand.en: to leave someone in a place they cannot leave

tradition.en: something people do regularly for years

cocoa.en: a hot drink made from chocolate

threaten.en: to be likely to cause harm

promise.en: to say you will definitely do something

rename.en: to give a new name to something

invent.en: to make or think of something new

escape.en: to get away from a bad place

shiver.en: to shake because you are cold

argue.en: to give reasons for your side
